title: Configure Microsoft Entra authentication with OpenID Connect

facts.text: Obtain and set up security certificates on Business Central deployment for secure WAN connections
Create Microsoft Entra tenant by signing up for Microsoft 365 plan or Azure subscription
Register Business Central application in Microsoft Entra tenant specifying name, account types, and redirect URI
Set ID tokens for implicit grant and hybrid flows in application authentication settings
Associate each Microsoft Entra user accessing Business Central with account having authentication email
Configure server instance credential type to AccessControlService and set Microsoft Entra settings
Configure web server components with AAD application ID and authority URI
For multitenant deployments using different Azure tenants, register app on one tenant and make it multitenant
